Cross-cutting pattern: The empty-string title gap (z.string() without .min(1)) was flagged independently by 4 agents across 3 WPs (WP-001 QA, WP-001 Reviewer, WP-001 Documentation, WP-002 QA). This recurring detection confirms it is a genuine validation gap worth a dedicated micro-WP, not a one-off observation. Similarly, the CreateWorkPackageSchema module-private architecture creates a systematic testability gap — the fix (export or integration test) addresses a class of issues, not just this instance.

outcome_summary: This project added title and description fields to the Work Package data model across all layers of the MCP server — storage schemas, the create-WP tool, the GUI project list and WP detail views, and the Bootstrapper persona. All 4 work packages passed 16 pipeline stages with zero rework; the test suite grew from 3960 to 3969 tests with TypeScript compiling clean throughout. The key follow-up items are a micro-WP to add .min(1) to CreateWorkPackageSchema.title (empty string accepted silently, flagged by 4 agents) and improving testability by exporting CreateWorkPackageSchema for direct test coverage.
project_summary: This project adds title and description fields to the Work Package data model so every WP carries human-readable identity and full specification content in the ledger. The title enables fast scanning in GUI list views and MCP tool output, while the description preserves the full WP spec body for rendering in the GUI detail view. Both fields are backward-compatible with existing WPs.
